content.comment_body: Hello experts, I have a [product_name] serial cable, but my computer does not have a serial port. Can I use a serial-to-USB adapter for this? Is such an adapter available from [company_name]? Thank you.
The article number for the [product_name] PC cable is [article_no]. Thank you.
Dear [user_name], I know the article number. My issue is that I already have several PC serial cables in my office and I only need the serial-to-USB adapter. Thank you.

Hi [user_name], There are many USB to serial cable converters available on the market and most work well with [product_name]. There was one previously recommended by [company_name] that could be ordered online from a shop in Germany. You can also find these converters at most computer shops. Important installation note: If your PC already has many virtual COM ports (from, for example, Bluetooth drivers), it's a good idea to remove those devices and their drivers before installing the USB-serial converter so it gets a low COM port number from Windows (typically under COM 6). Afterward, you can re-install the other devices. Always plug the converter into the same USB port to avoid Windows assigning new, higher COM port numbers. To set up, open [product_name] software, go to Tools > Options > Interface, and select the assigned COM port (you can find this in Windows Device Manager). Administrator rights are required for these changes. Hope this helps!
I think you can use any available adapter. [company_name] does not manufacture any dedicated adapter for this.
Hi, I saw your question and I am currently working on it. I'm trying to get it working under Windows 7.

analysis.insight_summary: The central challenge involves connecting older [product_name] serial communication cables to modern PCs that lack serial ports. Users are unsure whether standard USB-to-serial adapters are reliable for use with [company_name] hardware and related software, and whether [company_name] provides an official adapter. Discussions highlight confusion about hardware support and difficulties with virtual COM port configuration on Windows.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [company_name] to supply or recommend a compatible serial-to-USB adapter, enabling use of legacy cables with modern computers and ensuring a simple, reliable setup and communication with [product_name] hardware.
